talkingPoints.text: moisturizing, plump dewy glow, color lasts through 24h

benefits.text:
BBIA Eau Stay Mini Cushion helps even out skin tone, naturally covers imperfections and gives a smooth, plump, radiant base. Contains up to 65% moisturizing essence, helping skin stay moist and smooth all day.
Sun protection SPF40 PA+++
Color lasts continuously for up to 24 hours
Does not cause irritation, suitable for all skin types
Certified vegan by EVE VEGAN, France

howToUse.text:
Use the puff included in the cushion case to pick up an appropriate amount of product and pat evenly onto the face.
For areas that need extra coverage, a concealer can be used alongside for smooth, perfect skin.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: Moisturizing mini cushion for a plump, dewy look, suited to trying out, carrying with you or touching up your base during the day.

sellingPoints.text: Handy mini size to carry; contains 65% moisturizing essence; SPF40 PA+++.

texture.text: Mini cushion with a thin, moist base that melds with skin and a juicy feel.

claimDisclaimers.text: The benefit section of the documentation says “BBIA Eau Stay Mini Cushion” but the product name is Eau Glow Cushion Mini; the internal name needs to be rechecked.
